title: 22 June 1964: Mixing, editing: A Hard Day's Night album, Long Tall Sally EP songs
content:
Studios One and Two (control room), EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producer: George Martin
Engineer: Norman Smith

While The Beatles were on tour in New Zealand, George Martin and his team at EMI Studios created a number of mono and stereo mixes for the A Hard Day’s Night LP, and stereo mixes of songs already released on the Long Tall Sally EP.

The day was divided into four separate sessions. The first took place from 10-11.30am in the control room of Studio One:

  • ‘Any Time At All’ (mono mix)
  • ‘When I Get Home’ (mono)
  • ‘I’ll Be Back’ (mono)
  • ‘And I Love Her’ (mono)

The second session took place from 11.30am-1pm.

  • ‘And I Love Her’ (stereo mix)
  • ‘When I Get Home’ (stereo)
  • ‘Any Time At All’ (stereo)
  • ‘I’ll Be Back’ (stereo)
  • ‘If I Fell’ (stereo)
  • ‘A Hard Day’s Night’ (stereo)
  • ‘I Should Have Known Better’ (stereo)
  • ‘I’m Happy Just To Dance With You’ (stereo)
  • ‘I Call Your Name’ (two stereo mixes)
  • ‘I Call Your Name’ (editing two stereo mixes together)

Following a break for lunch, more stereo mixes were made from 2.30-5.30pm.

  • ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’ (stereo mix)
  • ‘You Can’t Do That’ (stereo)
  • ‘Tell Me Why’ (stereo)
  • ‘Things We Said Today’ (stereo)
  • ‘Matchbox’ (stereo)
  • ‘Slow Down’ (stereo)
  • ‘Long Tall Sally’ (stereo)
  • ‘I’ll Cry Instead’ (stereo mix of Section A)
  • ‘I’ll Cry Instead’ (stereo mix of Section B)
  • ‘I’ll Cry Instead’ (editing together stereo mixes of sections A and B)

The day’s final session switched to the control room of Studio Two, and lasted from 5.45-9pm. Tape copies were made of the following mixes:

  • ‘Slow Down’ (mono)
  • ‘Matchbox’ (mono)
  • ‘Things We Said Today’ (stereo)
Page last updated: 7 July 2022
